title: Hydrogenation of the liquid organic hydrogen carrier compound dibenzyltoluene – reaction pathway determination by                     <sup>1</sup>                     H NMR spectroscopy
abstract: The catalytic hydrogenation of the LOHC compound dibenzyltoluene (H0-DBT) was investigated by                     1                     H NMR spectroscopy in order to elucidate the reaction pathway of its charging process with hydrogen in the context of future hydrogen storage applications.
